title: WireEvent
description: One event the tag sends while consent allows collection with identifiers: the common envelope every event carries, and its properties.

schema_version.description: The wire schema's major version: this file's.

tag_version.description: The semver of the tag build that sent the event.

event_id.description: Minted by the tag for each event; with site_id, the key that makes redelivery idempotent.

client_ts.description: When the event happened, by the browser's clock: Unix epoch milliseconds.

referrer.description: The document's referrer, when it has one.

page_title.description: The document's title, when it has one.

language.description: The browser's language: a BCP 47 tag.

props.description: The event's own properties. Open for now; vetted shapes per event type come later.

Uuidv7.description: A UUID, version 7, in lower-case hex.

SiteId.description: The site's public id, as in the tag snippet and /cfg/<SITE_PUBLIC_ID>.json.

EventType.description: The event's name, such as pageview.

ConsentState.description: One category's consent: granted, denied, unknown (not yet decided) or no_cmp (the site has no consent manager).

Consent.description: The consent snapshot when the event was sent.
